source_differences: Upper-reservoir embankment heights: 23 m and 17 m (SENG) against 10 m and 15 m for the two earth embankments on the north-west and south-west sides (SENG, Perspektive energije). The two sources may define height differently.
Capacity: 185 MW turbine and 180 MW pump (SENG, power-technology, English Wikipedia) against 180 MW (Global Energy Monitor).
Annual generation: 426 GWh (SENG publication) against 280 GWh (ELES, Naš stik).
Commercial operation: en.wikipedia April 2010. Power-technology 2009. SENG: trial-operation permit Dec 2009.
Plant coordinate: 46.1027, 13.6707 (Global Energy Monitor) against 46.0838583, 13.6666500 (English Wikipedia), 2.1 km to the south. Which part of the plant each marks is not stated.
Capacity: 180 MW (gem.wiki) against 185 megawatts when producing electricity (en.wikipedia.org)
Start: 2009 (gem.wiki) against put into commercial use in April 2010 (en.wikipedia.org)
